hypothesis: An equal-weight BTC+ETH portfolio, each coin's exposure set by the average of four slow SMA-band trend signals, earns a positive after-cost return versus cash with a lower drawdown than holding.

origin.exploration: About 400 hourly rule configurations on BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, train 2018-08-01..2022-01-01, validation 2022-01-02..2024-01-01, cost 0.0012 per side. Data after 2023-12-31 was not used for selection.
origin.families_rejected: RSI dip-buying, Bollinger mean reversion, hour-of-day and weekday seasonality, taker-buy ratio, volume breakout, EMA cross, Donchian, time-series momentum: negative or near-zero validation after costs, or train-only.
origin.why_an_ensemble: Single SMA lengths were unstable in validation (50/50 portfolio validation Sharpe 0.75 at 1200h, 0.23 at 1800h, 0.43 at 2400h, 0.92 at 4800h, 0.01 at 7200h). Averaging lengths avoids picking a lucky peak.
origin.exploration_numbers_for_this_rule: 50/50 portfolio: train +1284% (Sharpe 1.70, max DD 43%), validation +44% (Sharpe 0.78, max DD 21%, 25 round trips); buy-and-hold validation -25% (max DD 70%). Shifted-position timing test over 2018-08..2023: p = 0.017 (BTC), 0.003 (ETH). Exploration numbers are not evidence; this spec fixes the rule before any run on later data.
origin.relation_to_v4_v5: v4 (BTC, SMA 2400h) and its forward phase are unchanged. v5 (v4 rule on 20 altcoins) failed; this spec does not use those coins.

position_scope: each coin long a fraction 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 1 of its sleeve, rest in cash; no leverage, no shorting, paper research only

data_source.files: https://data.binance.vision/data/spot/monthly/klines/{SYMBOL}/1h/{SYMBOL}-1h-YYYY-MM.zip (and the daily/ files for days after the last full month)
data_source.checksum: every zip verified against its .CHECKSUM (sha256) before use
data_source.timestamp_unit: milliseconds before 2025, microseconds from 2025; the runner normalises to UTC hours
data_source.gaps: bars are used in order as published; missing hours are counted and reported per coin; a gap longer than 24 hours inside an evaluated segment is an error

rule.name: sma_band_ensemble
rule.sub_signal: for each length N: sma = mean of the last N closes including the current bar; state 1 when close > sma * 1.02, state 0 when close < sma * 0.98, otherwise unchanged; initial state 0
rule.exposure: per coin: mean of the four sub-signal states
rule.parameter_search: none; lengths and band are fixed by this spec

clock.signal: exposure after the close of bar i
clock.execution: that exposure is held from the open of bar i+1 to the open of bar i+2
clock.warmup: signals may use closes before a segment start (past data only)

portfolio.weights: starting capital split 1/2 per coin; each sleeve compounds on its own; no rebalancing between sleeves
portfolio.equity: portfolio equity at each UTC hour = mean of the two sleeve equities

execution_and_costs.applied: on every exposure change, sleeve equity is multiplied by (1 - 0.0012 * |change in exposure|)

segments_utc.rules: each segment starts at exposure 0; no entry in its first 24 hours (embargo); open exposure is closed at the segment end with exit cost

portfolio: annualised Sharpe of hourly portfolio returns (mean/std * sqrt(8760))
round trips (sum over coins and sub-signals of 0->1 transitions)

baselines: 50/50 buy-and-hold of BTC and ETH with costs - information only, not used for pass/fail
v4 rule on the same two coins - information only

backcheck_evaluation.enforcement: runner refuses a second backcheck run (exclusive marker file next to the data)
backcheck_evaluation.contamination: SPENT WINDOW. BTC 2024-01-01..2026-11-01 was used by v3 and v4, ETH by v5 (v4 rule: ETH +51.8%, max DD 46.1%). The author knows the market path. The backcheck is a sanity check, not an out-of-sample test, and is reported as such.
backcheck_evaluation.if_fail: stop this hypothesis; no forward phase
backcheck_evaluation.if_pass: eligible for the forward phase; not a profitability claim

forward_evaluation.what: the same runner on klines published after this spec was committed; no orders, no VPS, paper only
forward_evaluation.runs: verdict computed once, on the full forward segment after 2027-11-17
forward_evaluation.interim_reads: allowed for information; they never change the rule, costs or criteria. Any change is a new spec and the forward window restarts.

known_limits: Round trips are few (exploration: about 13 a year for the portfolio). Even a forward pass is weak statistical evidence; fewer than a few hundred trades is not proof.
About 400 configurations were explored; part of the exploration result is selection luck.
BTC and ETH are highly correlated; two coins are not two independent tests.
The edge in exploration came mostly from avoiding bear markets (2022: rule -17%, hold -66%); in bull years the rule lags holding and in sideways markets it can take repeated small losses.
ETH trend signals were much weaker than BTC in 2022-2023 validation.
Next-open fills with 2 bp/side adverse price; fine for BTC/ETH spot at research size, not proof of live capacity.
